_doc: A druggist's bottle (#805; refs experiments/prop_lab/refs/doctor/): a round amber glass bottle (8 oz, tinctures kept from the light), its paper label round the front, a cork. A prop that shatters (GlassProp): thin glass, so a ball, a fall off a shelf (3.4 m/s) or 45 kPa breaks it and what's in it goes on the floor. Four labels in the period's style (SPT. AMMON. AROM., TINCT. CINCHONAE CO., EXT. ERGOTAE FL., VIN. COLCHICI): the Nth made wears label N mod 4 (`variants`). Drawn from glb:medicine_bottles (tools/blender/props/doctor_d2.py): the glass the kit's `glass:` look, the labels printed (pbr:medicine_labels), the cork and contents baked the gun way. Written by tools/props/doctor.py.
